title: The CD58-CD2 axis is co-regulated with PD-L1 via CMTM6 and shapes anti-tumor immunity
model: A375 melanoma cells, genome-wide Brunello knockout library (76,441 guides, no non-targeting controls), CD58 FACS sort
contrast: CD58-low vs CD58-mid sort, day 10 (2 vs 2 biological replicates; technical sorts and sequencing lanes summed)
paper_method: MAGeCK, run separately on each of four technical sort pairs (Supplemental Table 2)
paper_calls: 9 genes enriched at FDR 0.10 in all four MAGeCK comparisons, 21 in at least two, 60 in at least one; CD58 and CMTM6 highlighted
barcs_calls: 69 genes at FDR 0.10 (66 enriched in CD58-low); 128 when the 8 technical sorts are kept as libraries
verdict: BARCS ranks CD58 first and calls CMTM6 (#13), and every gene the authors' four MAGeCK runs call in at least two runs, with a rank correlation of 0.82; BARCS adds about 45 further consistent regulators, chiefly more GPI-anchor synthesis genes.
